data.body:
Implementation detail for this story (the description carries the decisions). Audit basis: `check_mcp_models.model_schemas()` on origin/main 083620b0 maps 20 of the 32 models (11 explicit `MODEL_SCHEMAS:25-37` + 9 by `_snake` convention); 12 are unmapped: `AttachCommitsResultOut, BridgeAccessStepOut, FileImpactItemOut, GateRunOut, GroundingBackendOut, PlanReviewHealth{Available,Target,Unavailable}Out, PushStatusOut, VerifyCommandItemOut, VerifyCompletionStatusOut, WriteAckOut`. `BridgeAccessStepOut`, `GroundingBackendOut`, `PlanReviewHealth*Out` are nested shapes already authored inline in `bridge_access_check.steps`, `grounding_info.backends`, `ticket_state.plan_review_health`; `FileImpactItemOut`/`VerifyCommandItemOut` are `common.schema.json#/$defs/file_impact_entry|verify_command_entry`.

Schema amendments (the only schema edits):
1. MCP-added properties absent from the schemas: `push_status` on claim/create/sign results and on transition/reopen; `cross_session_warning` on ticket_state, gate_result, transition_result. Add `common.$defs.push_status` (`state` required; `reason`, `detail`, `remote_ref`, `unpushed` string and `since` number, all optional) and `$ref` it from `claim_result`, `create_result`, `sign_result`, `transition_result`; add optional `cross_session_warning: {"type":"string"}` to `ticket_state`, `gate_result`, `transition_result`.
2. Four new files: `write_ack.schema.json` (`result` required; `push_status` $ref, `description_warning`, `cross_session_warning` optional strings); `attach_commits_result.schema.json` (`ticket_id`, `attached` required); `gate_run.schema.json` (`job_id`, `status` required; `ticket_id`, `gate_type`, `verdict`, `error`, `durable`, `findings` optional; `additionalProperties: true`); `verify_completion_status.schema.json` (`ok`, `verdict`, `reason` required; `verified_at_sha` `["string","null"]`; `signed_at` `["integer","string","null"]`).
3. Nullability the mirror invented (model `X | None`, schema non-null) needs NO amendment; absence is the unset form: `BridgeAccessCheckOut.reason`; `BridgeControlOut.paused_at/reason/who`; `BridgeStatusOut.detail/detail_status/live_lock_fence/lock_holder/lock_lease_secs/lock_oid`; `ClarityResultOut.passed/reason`; `FsckOut.returncode`; `GateResultOut.ac_items/criteria_count/file_impact/keyword_count/line_count/passed`; `NextBatchOut.available_pool/batch_size/epic_title`; `TicketStateOut.close_class/close_reason/completion_expectation/creation_channel/creation_channel_inferred/detected_by/force_close_reason`.
4. Enums the mirror dropped (schema has enum, model `str`): `ClaimResultOut.status`, `ClarityResultOut.verdict`, `GateResultOut.verdict`, `PlanReviewStatusOut.verdict` (its file is owned by the LLM-leftovers epic; load whatever the file says), `SearchResultOut.status/ticket_type`, `TicketStateOut.status/ticket_type/close_class/completion_expectation/creation_channel`, `VerifySignatureResultOut.trust_basis/verdict`. Advertised schemas get stricter; real results already validate (`test_canonical_tool_result_validates`).
5. Required sets the mirror relaxed (schema requires, model optional): `DepsGraphOut.{blockers,children,deps}`, `GroundingInfoOut` (7), `PlanReviewStatusOut.{signed_at,verified_at_sha}`, `SignResultOut.manifest`, `TicketStateOut.tags`, `ValidateReportOut` (5). No model requires anything the schema does not.
6. `additionalProperties`: `BridgeFsckOut`/`GroundingInfoOut` models `True`, schemas `false`; canonical wins.
7. Schema-only properties (`CreateResultOut.title`, `NextBatchOut.tasks`, `WorkflowRunOut` x6) are optional keys a tool never emits; harmless under `docs/api-stability.md:23`.

Wire measurement (temp store, real `build_server().call_tool`): `show_ticket` emits 44 keys / 12 explicit nulls where the library emits 36 keys / 6 nulls; mirror-added nulls are `cross_session_warning, last_reopened_at, source_author, source_created_at, source_env, source_id` plus `attestations: {}`. A lean `ready_tickets` row: 44 wire keys vs 33 library keys (mirror-added `attestations, comments, cross_session_warning, description, inbound_deps, last_reopened_at, plan_review_health, source_*`, the re-added defaults `_mcp_budget.py:118-124` documents). Write acks carry five `push_status` nulls (`reason, detail, remote_ref, unpushed, since`) where `rebar.push_status()` returns `{"state":"ok"}`.

Mechanism verified by prototype over `mcp.shared.memory.create_connected_server_and_client_session` (mcp 1.29.0, pydantic 2.13.4): a tool annotated `-> dict[str, Any]` gets FastMCP's pass-through `RootModel[dict[str, Any]]` output model (`func_metadata._try_create_model_and_schema`); `-> list[dict[str, Any]]` wraps as `{"result": [...]}` (`wrap_output=True`); setting `tool.fn_metadata.output_schema` to a self-contained schema makes `list_tools()` advertise it (`Tool.output_schema` is a `cached_property` over `fn_metadata.output_schema`) and the lowlevel validator accepts absent optionals.

Test rewrites (model access to dict/wire access): `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py` (move `transition_ticket`/`reopen_ticket` from `NO_SCHEMA_EXEMPT` to `CANONICAL`; `EXEMPT_GENERIC` write acks become `CANONICAL: write_ack`; `attach_commits`, `gate_status`, `verify_completion_status` map to their new schemas; keep the partition guards), `test_mcp.py:370-395` (delete the pydantic-absent test), `test_internal_shim_removal_e54e_heldout.py:39-46` (assert `importlib.util.find_spec("rebar._mcp_models") is None`), `test_mcp_js_safe_integers.py:183-215` (walk advertised `outputSchema`s), `test_mcp_list_read_surface.py:307-318` (dict rows), `test_library.py:66-68`, `test_bridge_programmatic_heldout.py:189-215`, `test_reconcile_cli_state_removal_82bb_heldout.py:14,80`, `tests/interfaces/queries/test_validate_compute.py:138`, `test_next_batch_compute.py:410`, `tests/unit/{test_attestation_signing.py:292-301, test_harness_provenance.py:180-187, test_claimed_session_read.py:66-72, test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py:367-376, test_plan_review_health_surfaces.py:11,124-134,202,224-235, test_cross_session_mcp.py:130-204,282-296, test_mcp_writes.py:70-89, test_description_cap_warning.py:272-293, test_caused_by_link_validation.py:274, test_create_duplicate_warning.py:217-218, test_mcp_plan_review_status.py:129,152,176}`.

Baseline maintenance: this story removes the CI step `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:765-773` (a censused `ci_gate` workflow `run:` step) and `scripts`-adjacent `src/rebar/schemas/check_mcp_models.py`. Because `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py:357-364` asserts the committed baseline equals the live tree, run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in the same change and commit `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` (operator-sanctioned on the epic; precedent commit 81da792). State the sanction in the commit message.
